column3: The mockery is attributed to the cup bringing scorn rather than to the woman becoming a mockery.
“Dash it to pieces” replaces gnawing its fragments.
“In the fire” specifies the passing through; children renders sons.
“You sisters” replaces they in the opening clause; messengers replaces singular messenger.
The crown is rendered in the plural.
“For that is all she is” expands the final and she.
“Slept with” renders coming in to her.
“Consequences of” specifies the bearing of sins.
